excluded_record_justifications.verification/candidate-fingerprint-r9-fi: Self-referential final record; its declared candidate scope is independently recomputed.
excluded_record_justifications.verification/candidate-fingerprint-r9-fr: Self-referential freeze record; its declared candidate scope is independently recomputed.
Post-freeze generated distribution report; its exact bytes and archive/package bindings are validated by release_audit.
excluded_record_justifications.verification/triple-aaa-independent-crit: Post-freeze reviewer-owned record; its exact bytes and scope binding are validated by release_audit.

scope_policy.reason: Only self-referential and post-freeze generated/reviewer-owned records are excluded; all release-critical claim surfaces remain in the candidate scope.

release_critical_surfaces.policy: Each release-critical claim surface is included in the candidate manifest. Post-freeze reviewer/distribution records are validated by release_audit after the candidate is frozen.

limitations: The fingerprint proves byte identity for the declared source/evidence scope, not audiovisual semantic quality.
Generated media and model weights are represented by hash-bound records and release exclusions, not copied into the candidate scope.
Post-freeze reviewer and distribution records are not part of the self-referential manifest; their exact bytes and scope claims must be validated by the release audit.
